wording: This workspace was set up before the student loan questions were added, so it cannot record the answers this statement needs yet. The deduction stays blocked until the workspace is updated; nothing is assumed in the meantime.
notes: 2025 Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet (i1040gi.pdf p.99), lines 2-9, publishing Schedule 1 line 21, as an ADR 0077 Part 4 presence selection. Successor to v2, which let the four retained yes/no answers select the old path and dropped them from the new one. The worksheet arithmetic, the cap, the MAGI phase-out, the filing-status, scope, Part II and legal-zero checks are v1's nonempty branch, byte for byte (rule.sli-worksheet.json value.else). Path yes-no-answers is active only when a statement carries the replaced no-non-qualified-loan-component answer; it reads each statement's five answer statuses with coverage (ADR 0077 Part 3), so a statement without its own answer refuses naming that statement instead of being let through by another statement's yes (the Track 0a fail-open fix). Path loan-links is active when any statement carries a statement-keyed relationship fact (affirmed, cannot-tell, denied or withdrawn inclusion, the statement-level doubt, or the replay applicability marker); it is the same branch with only the replaced answer taken out of the universal check: the four retained answers stay there, read per statement with coverage, and every current statement's line-21 standing must then be none (its conclusion plain-case-supported) or the line refuses DEPENDENCY_INVALID. A missing retained answer refuses naming its statement; a no is SLI_UNIVERSAL_COMPONENT_VIOLATION, as in v1. Both paths active refuses with old-and-new-sli-inputs-both-present (owner decision 2: only the replaced answer conflicts with loan links). Neither: a closed family with no box 1 publishes 0; a nonempty family refuses through the standing read. Each path and the default keep v1's require_closed. wording is line 21's sentence, in place of statement reasons, when the workspace has not adopted every fact type the selected path's activity names, so it cannot record what that path decides on.
